name: Hokaku Rape ~Machijuu no Onna wa Subete Ore no Emono~
original_name: 捕獲レイプ～町中の女は全て俺の獲物～
source:
Student, idol, nurse, wife, escort... females of 
all ages and types populate this town. 
The protagonist victimizes each one. 

Business district, alleyway, hospital, library... 
wherever a female appears, click to try and abduct her. 
Get in close without giving away your motives, 
and soon she will be your personal object. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102582.html]DLsite English[/url]]
